This is my second time purchasing, there's a noticeable difference in my under eyes after I wear these. I put them on for a couple hours before I go out and I look so much more refreshed and my dark circles are gone, love em

The eye patches stay put while I walk around my home doing chores and folding laundry. im not sure why some people say they don't stay on, perhaps they aren't applying them correctly. The gel patches absorb serum, making them slightly slippery, but they still stay in place. I plan to bring these with me whenever I travel to help soothe my tired eyes. While I haven't noticed a significant improvement yet, I do feel that my under-eye area looks more refreshed. I love the soothing sensation and have noticed they help reduce puffiness and make my dark circles less pronounced. I enjoy using these at night because they contain retinol and peptides, along with arnica extract to target fine lines, dark circles, and puffiness. I love waking up looking more well-rested the next day!

I never write reviews, but I had to for these. I wore these last night for eight hours woke up this morning with no eye bags and looking refreshed. Usually when I wake up, my skin is saggy or puffy or both…. I have sensitive skin and these did not irritate my skin at all. I actually rubbed all the extra theorem all over my face and neck. I really wish it had Cleaner ingredients but it works so well I will definitely repurchase. Im 42 and have always had tired eyes..
